faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do the people I share with need an app?
faq.a1: No. Your card opens in any browser. They can save your contact, add your card to their wallet or reach you in one tap.
faq.q2: Is Apple Wallet and Google Wallet support real?
faq.a2: Yes. Kardify generates signed .pkpass files using Apple's PassKit format and official Google Wallet Generic Passes.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Create separate cards for different roles, companies or languages and manage them from one dashboard.
faq.q4: What happens when I update my information?
faq.a4: Your public card updates instantly, and wallet passes already saved on phones receive the update automatically.
faq.a5: Yes. The whole platform is available in English and Arabic with full right-to-left layout, and your card keeps the language you write it in.
faq.q6: How do you handle visitor privacy?
faq.a6: We only store anonymous, aggregated engagement data. No IP addresses or personal visitor details are stored with analytics.
faq.a7: Yes. Kardify is completely free, with no paid plans. Every feature is included: unlimited cards, wallet passes, QR codes and analytics.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Answers to common questions and ways to reach us.
help.contactBody: Our team replies within one business day.
help.q1: How do I share my card?
help.a1: Open a card from My Cards and use Share. You can copy the link, use the native share sheet, WhatsApp, email or download the QR code.
help.q2: Why can't visitors see my card?
help.a2: Only active (published) cards are public. Open the card and click Publish or Activate.
help.a3: When you edit a published card, Apple Wallet devices are notified via push and Google Wallet objects are updated automatically.
help.a4: Each QR code contains your card link with a scan marker. Repeated scans by the same visitor within 30 minutes count once.
help.q5: Can I change my card's link?
help.a5: Yes — open the card and use Regenerate link. Old links and printed QR codes will stop working.

legal.termsBody: By using Kardify you agree to provide accurate information, to only publish content you have the right to share, and not to use the service for spam or unlawful purposes. Kardify may suspend cards that violate these terms. The service is provided as-is.
legal.privacyBody: We store the information you enter in your account and cards. Public cards are visible to anyone with the link. Visitor analytics are anonymous: we store a hashed random session identifier and the referring website's domain — never IP addresses. You can export or delete your data at any time from Account Settings.
